// Fixture for the fetch-seam guard's own test. Deliberately violating; the .txt
// extension keeps it out of the build and out of tsconfig.
export async function bad() {
  await fetch("https://example.com");
  navigator.sendBeacon("https://example.com", "x");
  const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
  const ws = new WebSocket("wss://example.com");
  const es = new EventSource("https://example.com/stream");
  return { xhr, ws, es };
}
